actions.name: start_focus_session
actions.description: Use when the user wants a focus or pomodoro session, e.g. 'give me a focus block' or 'start a 25 minute pomodoro'. Convert their request to seconds.

seconds.description: Session length in seconds — e.g. 25 minutes is 1500. Use 1500 if the user doesn't say.

actions.name: start_break
actions.description: Use when the user finishes a focus session and wants a short break timer.
